commit.message:
Add platform analytics loader

Embeds <script src=".../v1/analytics.js?app=<id>" defer></script> into
web/index.html so visits start showing up in the creator dashboard. The
loader is served from the platform Worker; tags evolve without a redeploy.

fix: declare maskable icon purpose for Android PWA install

Android Chrome installs PWAs as launcher shortcuts (not real apps with
their own task slot) unless the manifest declares at least one icon
with purpose: 'maskable'. Add 'any maskable' to both 192/512 entries
so installs land in the app drawer with an adaptive icon.

chore: bump @freegamestore/games to 0.13.1 (grid catalog icon)

The catalog link's icon in GameTopbar moved from a house silhouette
to a 2×2 grid. On Android Chrome the old icon visually collided
with the browser's own home button.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add platform analytics loader

Embeds <script src=".../v1/analytics.js?app=<id>" defer></script> into
web/index.html so visits start showing up in the creator dashboard. The
loader is served from the platform Worker; tags evolve without a redeploy.

fix: declare maskable icon purpose for Android PWA install

Android Chrome installs PWAs as launcher shortcuts (not real apps with
their own task slot) unless the manifest declares at least one icon
with purpose: 'maskable'. Add 'any maskable' to both 192/512 entries
so installs land in the app drawer with an adaptive icon.

Strip multiplayer — moving to ProGameStore

Cloudflare Pages can't host a Worker that defines a Durable Object class,
so the WebSocket-backed multiplayer was failing every deploy. Per the
platform decision in ~/dev/stores/CLAUDE.md (2026-05-20), real-time rooms
are now a Pro-tier feature, not Free. Multiplayer chess will live at
progamestore-online/chess once PGS is built out.

Removed:
- web/public/_worker.js (the GameDO Worker)
- web/src/components/MultiplayerTab.tsx
- /multiplayer + /g/<id> routes in App.tsx
- Multiplayer button in the topbar
- Manual sw.js registration in index.html (VitePWA handles it)
- Durable Objects + migrations blocks in wrangler.jsonc

The full multiplayer code is staged at ~/dev/stores/pgs/games/chess/ for
the eventual PGS launch.

Kept: local play vs. engine, puzzles, voice control, preferences,
analysis, eval bar, move list ��� everything that doesn't need a server.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
